label: Ymer
comment: Fermented thinly, then drained of half its volume as whey and topped up with cream.
note: Danish ymer is soured skimmed milk that is drained of about half its volume as whey, then blended and topped up with cream to about 3.5 % fat.

about.text: A Danish concentrated soured milk, first sold commercially in the 1930s: skimmed milk fermented with mesophilic cultures, drained of about half its volume as whey and blended smooth, with cream added to about 3.5 % fat. About 5–6 g protein per 100 g, so thick and spoonable.

how.text: The curd is cut and warmed so it gives up its whey by syneresis; it is then kept above 35 °C while it is blended smooth, and cream is added afterwards. The temperatures and times come from Wikipedia alone.
